user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Successful request with valid email
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with a valid email address in the email field.
Verify the response message indicates that a recovery email has been sent.
positive.expected_result: Response status code is 200 and the message confirms that the recovery email has been sent.

negative.title: Request with missing email field
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint without the email field.
Verify the response message indicates that an email is required.
negative.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and the message indicates that the email field is required.

edge.title: Request with invalid email format
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an invalid email format (e.g., 'invalid-email').
Verify the response message indicates that the email format is invalid.
edge.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and the message indicates that the email format is invalid.
